title: Everyday Phrases — A Yoga Class
title_quote: Are you going to a yoga class?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧘 實用瑜伽課必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Yoga Class
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用瑜伽課情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從報名課程、帶墊子進教室，到下犬式、樹式與大休息放鬆，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Yoga Class phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering booking a class, bringing your mat, poses like downward dog and tree pose, and cooling down. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you going to a yoga class?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ə ˈjoʊɡə klæs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What kind of yoga is it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think it is slow yoga.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, maybe a bit more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my own mat?
dialogue.zh: 我一定要自備瑜伽墊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring yours to be safe.
dialogue.zh: 還是帶自己的比較保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they wipe them every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I rent a mat there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I change my clothes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a small back room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave my bag there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lockers are by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but lock it in a locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt lɑk ɪt ɪn ə ˈlɑkər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels better that way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nice and cool in there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they keep the room cold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a bit, so the air feels fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə bɪt, soʊ ði ɛr filz frɛʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is upstairs, near the park.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look for the green door.
dialogue.zh: 好找，看到綠色的門就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pay at the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to sign up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just sign this short form.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one calm teacher leads it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, everyone just closes their eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is okay, no one looks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I too old for this?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to be strong?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I say I am new?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she will help you more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laugh and try again, that's it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cold water at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I buy my own blocks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They help you reach the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything else to bring?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just you and an open mind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we are on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, I need to relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your mat, see you there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we get a good spot?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put your mat next to mine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stand on my mat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, just sit down first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have your phone out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check it one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ɪt wʌn mɔr taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這首輕柔的曲子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, it is so calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 找個舒服的姿勢坐就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The teacher says breathe in now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我呼吸聲音太大聲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just breathe nice and easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow breaths are harder than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ brɛθz ɑr ˈhɑrdər ðæn aɪ θɔt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room is very quiet now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you sleep well last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not much, so I am tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, yawn if you need to.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is too dark to see.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine, eyes stay closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she can see you well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那面大鏡子讓我不自在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡每個人好像都很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他們比我們早開始很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 下一個動作是什麼來著？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we do this pose before?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is a new one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is one full breath?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four counts in, six counts out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I counted the breaths wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put your hands on your knees.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sit up really tall?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sit up long and straight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift your chest just a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Be still, you are doing well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The teacher walks past us now.
dialogue.zh: 老師從我們身邊走過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她輕輕幫你調整小地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she just touch my shoulder?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she said, let it drop.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就非常慢慢地轉一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't watch the clock, just breathe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes feel like an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 安靜時時間感覺怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I am ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand up and fold forward slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的膝蓋可以彎一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small bend is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lift your hips up high.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heels don't reach the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine, keep them up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的手臂像橡皮一樣軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, now I press my hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do we hold this?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs pull at the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend your knees, don't force it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, round my back like a cat?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, raʊnd maɪ bæk laɪk ə kæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pose has a funny name.
dialogue.zh: 這個動作的名字真好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 狗狗就是這樣伸懶腰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step one foot between your hands.
dialogue.zh: 把一隻腳踩到雙手中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我前面的膝蓋蹲得好深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way should my foot point?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms get heavy so fast.
dialogue.zh: 我的手臂一下子就好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we try the tree pose.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the raised foot go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Place it low on your calf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 發抖是不是不好的跡象？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay a bit, don't come down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady beside me is perfect.
dialogue.zh: 我旁邊那位女士做得完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, she started years ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 老師在我旁邊停了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She helps you with your hips.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她說，臀部要微微轉一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does a flat back feel like?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ə flæt bæk fil laɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, now your back is long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe in as you rise up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out as you fold down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I move on her count?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，跟著呼吸流動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay here if you need rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's normal, one side works harder.
dialogue.zh: 很正常，兩邊力氣本來就不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just ten minutes left, almost done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit during the flow?
dialogue.zh: 串流中間我可以坐著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My whole body is warm now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we lie all the way down.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi laɪ ɔl ðə weɪ daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your back on the mat.
dialogue.zh: 讓背部舒服地靠在墊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is called great rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet fall open on their own.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit fɔl ˈoʊpən ɔn ðɛr oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我的腳自己向外打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let your arms rest wide too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The music is so quiet now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let your body go heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我今天腦袋一直轉個不停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal, let thoughts pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bell rang to end it.
dialogue.zh: 鈴聲響起，這一階段結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我的肩都沉下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們現在可以去喝水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm water is by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這杯溫水喝起來好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是抖動的姿勢造成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I skip the next class?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do them at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick the time you can keep.
dialogue.zh: 選你真的能固定的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可是你一路都跟得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，她幫你調整得又輕又好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her words were easy to follow.
dialogue.zh: 她的口令很容易跟著做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們現在就訂兩個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, before they fill up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy a class pack?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you come twice a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每週任何一堂課都能上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, try one more class first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們寫下我們的名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes early, same as us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, it clears my head.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，上完腦袋好清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll sit in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一碗熱湯聽起來剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time for the next class?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, seven, I'll text you tonight.
dialogue.zh: 對，七點，我今晚傳訊息給你。
